# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 23 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 23 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_023_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 23

**23:1** At the hour of the morning offering, the priests were standing ready, waiting for Zechariah to come and offer the customary blessing — but he did not come. One of the priests at last summoned the courage to enter the sanctuary, and he saw congealed blood beside the altar of the Lord. And a voice said: "Zechariah has been slain. His blood will not be wiped clean until his avenger comes."

**23:2** Hearing this, the priest was gripped with fear. He went out and reported to the other priests what he had seen and heard. They gathered their courage and went in together and saw what had occurred. The wainscoting panels of the temple cried out in lamentation, and the priests tore their garments from top to bottom.

**23:3** They searched for his body and could not find it, but they found his blood had turned to stone. They went out in fear and reported to the people that Zechariah had been slain. All the tribes of the people heard the news, mourned for him, and lamented three days and three nights.

**23:4** After the three days, the priests deliberated about who should be appointed in his place. The lot fell to Simeon — the very man to whom the Holy Spirit had revealed that he would not see death until he had seen the Christ in the flesh.
